name: GDPR
description: General Data Protection Regulation — EU regulation on data protection and privacy for individuals within the European Union and the European Economic Area.

controls.title: Principles relating to processing of personal data
controls.description: Personal data must be processed lawfully, fairly, transparently, for specified purposes, minimized, accurate, stored no longer than necessary, and processed with appropriate security.

controls.title: Lawfulness of processing
controls.description: Processing shall be lawful only if at least one of the following applies: consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, or legitimate interests.

controls.title: Conditions for consent
controls.description: Where processing is based on consent, the controller shall be able to demonstrate that the data subject has consented. Consent must be freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous.

controls.title: Processing of special categories of personal data
controls.description: Processing of data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, genetic data, biometric data, health data, or data concerning sex life is prohibited unless specific conditions are met.

controls.title: Transparent information, communication and modalities
controls.description: The controller shall take appropriate measures to provide information to the data subject in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form.

controls.title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject
controls.description: Where personal data are collected from the data subject, the controller shall provide the data subject with specific information at the time of collection.

controls.title: Right of access by the data subject
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller confirmation as to whether or not personal data concerning him or her are being processed.

controls.title: Right to rectification
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller without undue delay the rectification of inaccurate personal data.

controls.title: Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten')
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller the erasure of personal data concerning him or her without undue delay.

controls.title: Right to data portability
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to receive the personal data concerning him or her in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

controls.title: Right to object
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to object, on grounds relating to his or her particular situation, at any time to processing of personal data concerning him or her.

controls.title: Responsibility of the controller
controls.description: Taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing, the controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures.

controls.title: Data protection by design and by default
controls.description: The controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures for ensuring that, by default, only personal data which are necessary for each specific purpose of the processing are processed.

controls.title: Processor
controls.description: Where processing is to be carried out on behalf of a controller, the controller shall only use processors providing sufficient guarantees to implement appropriate technical and organisational measures.

controls.title: Records of processing activities
controls.description: Each controller and processor shall maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.description: The controller and processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.

controls.title: Notification of personal data breach to supervisory authority
controls.description: In the case of a personal data breach, the controller shall without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, notify the supervisory authority.

controls.title: Data protection impact assessment
controls.description: Where a type of processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, the controller shall carry out an assessment of the impact.

controls.title: Designation of the data protection officer
controls.description: The controller and the processor shall designate a data protection officer in certain cases involving public authorities or large-scale processing of special categories of data.
